status: FINAL — awaiting owner approval. Single use. Final qualification attempt for the current FONT-04 method family.
purpose: Single-use held-out synthetic qualification population P2pp for the frozen cover-2.0-ceiling-q3 candidate.

generator.layout: v1.1: each DPI schedule split in order into sheets of 32 lines; full final scan bbox must fit the 6x9 in sheet or generation fails; geometry-only precheck before opening

seed_derivation.rule: first 8 hex digits of SHA-256, unsigned big-endian; +17000+i, +31000, +47000 offsets unchanged

family_ancestry_audit: EB Garamond (Duffner; Garamond revival), Lato (Dziedzic; humanist sans), Inconsolata (Levien; Consolas-inspired mono). Development families: DejaVu/Bitstream Vera, FreeSerif/FreeSans/FreeMono, C059 (Century), NimbusMonoPS/FreeMono (Courier), Z003, Liberation (Times/Arial/Courier metrics), P052 (Palatino), NimbusRoman (Times), NimbusSans (Helvetica), URW Bookman, Noto Sans Mono, IBM Plex Serif/Sans/Mono, URW Gothic (Avant Garde), Bitstream Charter. No Garamond, humanist-sans Lato, or Inconsolata design appears in any development set. Competing siblings: EB Garamond 12 Regular/Italic/Bold plus 08-point optical-size Regular/Italic (near-identical siblings); Lato Light/Regular/Semibold/Bold weight ladder plus Italic/BoldItalic. Only one Inconsolata face is packaged.

licensing.rule: Font binaries and generated P2pp pages are never committed; only hashes, manifests and compact metrics.

arms: cover-2.0-ceiling (reference; source of positive controls), binary d3a26c6d...
evaluation.conversion: each of the 9 sheets converted once per arm at its native DPI, clearscan profile, OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=1 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4; candidate converted twice (determinism)
evaluation.pristine_method: unchanged r2b_pristine/r2c_pristine method: composited pristine page, original observation boxes, PDFium and Poppler at native DPI

margins.source: 6 independent default-vs-default realizations generated from FONT-01 train faces with fresh seeds (p2pp_calibration.py); no P2/P2prime/development data

pass_criteria.functional: Candidate text extraction (Poppler default/layout/raw, PDFium, MuPDF) and native PDFium search identical to default on every sheet; qpdf --check clean; OTS sanitizes every embedded font; repeat conversion byte-identical.
pass_criteria.numerical_non_inferiority: For every character class with >=10 observations and each renderer: candidate mean error - default mean error <= mean_margin(class, renderer) and candidate p95 - default p95 <= p95_margin(class, renderer), margins from p2pp-margins.json. A class absent from the margin file is reported and counted as FAIL.
pass_criteria.regression_tail: Per renderer, with tau = tail_threshold(renderer) from p2pp-margins.json: W = occurrences with candidate - default error > tau, B = occurrences with default - candidate > tau. FAIL if a one-sided exact binomial (sign) test of W versus B at p < 0.05 indicates more worsening than improvement.
pass_criteria.material_defects: Blinded review: zero newly introduced class (iii) material changes in the candidate arm, relative to default on the same occurrence. Class (iii): wrong character, wrong numeral, counter opened or closed, weight/slant/style-class change, unsupported added or removed stroke. Class (i) harmless visual difference and class (ii) justified restoration (ink missing from a damaged scan and supported by the other witnesses) are not failures.
pass_criteria.economy: Report only: substituted members, retired/added/net outlines (CID->GID), actual font bytes, PDF bytes, runtime, peak RSS. No economy threshold.

power_disclosure: Calibrated from independent realizations, the numerical criteria are guards against broad degradation, not detectors of individual typography errors: applied retrospectively to the failed cover-2.0 arm on P2 they fail one class in PDFium only, and the tail sign test is not significant. Qualification therefore rests on the blinded material-defect review; this is stated in advance.

population: every candidate non-self admitted substitution (all, no sampling)
every occurrence with candidate - default error > 0.5 x tau in either renderer (review-selection rule, not a pass threshold)
positive controls: up to 100 reference-arm substitutions not admitted by the candidate, random with recorded seed, shuffled in to estimate grader sensitivity (reported, not a pass criterion)
blind_review.format: per row: source scan crop with word context | arm X | arm Y, X/Y = default vs candidate (or default vs reference for controls), randomized per row; shown at native 100% and 200%; target glyph boxed; no filenames or size hints
blind_review.visibility_rule: An arm difference counts only if the reviewer can distinguish it from the source glyph at 100% or 200%; 400% views are informational only. The font-outline xor proxy is reported but is not a pass/fail criterion.
blind_review.grading: Grade class (i)/(ii)/(iii) per arm with reason; commit all grades before unsealing; key and oracle census sealed under local/P2pp/sealed with SHA-256 commitments committed before grading.

single_use: Evaluate exactly once with the frozen candidate. No code, constant, margin, population or criterion change after opening. If P2pp fails materially, preserve results and reassess the approach; do not launch another holdout automatically.
opening_guard: r2b_generator.py --split p2pp refuses to generate unless this file hash is in method-freeze-q3.json as p2pp_preregistration_sha256, owner approval of this hash is recorded as p2pp_owner_approval, every face hash matches, the binary hash matches the freeze, and local/P2pp/OPENED does not exist.
